findings.claim: A saved own warning with an empty tail ('areas unknown for goal <id>') renders an empty reason ('at T: ; overlap') instead of 'the claim recorded no reason'.
findings.evidence: goal_show_view.go:70-72 accepts tail == "" and sets reason to ""; internal/goal/areas.go:136-138 writes the bare form only when a reader returns an unknown snapshot without warnings, which no production reader does (claim_areas.go:23,29,41,52; areas.go:77,105,116).
findings.change: Treat an empty tail like no matching warning.
findings.relation: new; rule: a missing reason renders as 'the claim recorded no reason'

findings.claim: The new claimed-state guard on the Edit areas section has no test.
findings.evidence: goal_show_view.go:63 adds file.State == goal.StateClaimed; no case in TestGoalShowSaysTheSavedClaimsAreas shows a non-claimed goal with area metadata. The brief's T5 asks only for the no-metadata case.
findings.change: Optionally add a non-claimed case with metadata that asserts no section.
findings.relation: new; rule: each added guard has a test that fails without it

findings.claim: For a malformed declaration, the shown reason reads 'in design <path>' and does not say that the declaration is malformed.
findings.evidence: claim_areas.go:41 and areas.go:105 save no cause. D5 prescribes the saved tail. The logged page for the malformed case confirms it.
findings.change: None in this unit; a later list item if wanted.
findings.relation: new; rule: D5 prints the saved tail verbatim

findings.claim: The held and slot sentences name only the first held goal or slot, where the old text listed them all.
findings.evidence: reservation.go:66-73 uses block.Held, as D4 prescribes; verbs.go:1505-1511 joined every held goal or slot into the old text.

findings.claim: TestGoalShowSaysTheSavedClaimsAreas is in goal-decision-standard, whose inputs list neither goal_show_view.go nor a_verb_says_its_own_result_test.go.
findings.evidence: testing.json goal-decision-standard inputs; U1a's tests in landing-command-standard have the same gap. Whether inputs drive impact selection was not checked.
findings.change: Optionally add the two files to the group's inputs.
findings.relation: new; rule: a fixture group's inputs name the files its tests cover

findings.claim: T6 was built as a new test with four outcome subtests that carry the negatives, not as a subtest plus negatives on the existing test.
findings.evidence: person_claims_test.go:369 now requires only 'also holds'; TestPersonClaimQuotaAdviceSaysTheBlockerOutcome asserts the sentence for each outcome and the forbidden words. Its coverage is wider and its mutation result is the same.
